DiagnosticCode.description:
Stable machine-readable diagnostic code.

Consumers must treat an unknown `LW_*` code as blocking. The newtype is intentionally open so
additive diagnostics do not force a wire-version change.

ExecutionObjectRef.description: One Kubernetes object owned by an execution generation.

apiVersion.description: Exact API version used to address the object, such as `batch/v1`.

resource.description: Kubernetes collection name, such as `jobs` or `configmaps`.

uid.description: Server-assigned UID proving ownership; never reused after deletion.

description:
Deterministic result of one cleanup attempt.

A caller may only confirm Resource release for [`Self::Confirmed`]. `Pending` and `Unknown`
must keep the attempt unresolved and must never be rewritten as released.

oneOf.description: Every owned object is verifiably gone.
At least one owned object still exists; the next cleanup pass continues.
Cleanup could not be determined; the caller keeps the unresolved diagnostic.

title: ExecutionCleanupStatus
